name: Blades of Judgment
findings: 300-Ki Ultimate in the canonical Xenoverse 2 record; associated with Fused Zamasu
PQ112 — Advent of the Mighty God Zamasu! lists the skill in Basic Reward
Holding input increases the number of red energy blades
Blades striking terrain/surroundings can explode; after a knockaway the blades can steer toward the target
Dragon Ball Wiki labels the move a Super Skill, conflicting with the repository's Ultimate classification; the discrepancy is retained
Exact blade count, damage scaling, frame data, and drop probability remain unresolved
